name: ABRASIVES MANUFACTURING ( Under Liquidation ) SAOG
hq: Rusail Industrial Estate, Sultanate of Oman
description: Abrasives Manufacturing Company SAOG is currently Under Liquidation and listed on the MSX Under_Monitoring Market, with formal wind-down status and no active commercial filings since 2019. Originally founded in July 1997 and listed on the Muscat Stock Exchange in January 2002 with OMR 1.00 million paid-up capital, the company historically operated a manufacturing plant at Rusayl Industrial Estate producing industrial abrasive products for construction materials and metalworking support sectors in Oman. Following Extraordinary and Annual General Meeting resolutions in 2019, normal operations ceased and the listing remains in liquidation with minimal residual market capitalization (OMR 40,000 across 206 registered shareholders).
highlights: Classified Under Liquidation on the MSX Under_Monitoring Market with no financial statements published since its unaudited FY2018 income statement and 2019 AGM/EGM resolutions.
Historically operated industrial abrasives manufacturing facilities in Rusayl Industrial Estate with OMR 1.00 million paid-up capital (1.00 million shares).
